work.title: Inventory and Order Coordination
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, recorded discrepancies, and routed missing item inquiries to the appropriate staff.
Organized stockroom supplies, maintained order paperwork, and coordinated pickup schedules with staff to support routine fulfillment activities.

projects.title: Logistic Regression Baseline for Customer Churn Prediction
bullets: Implemented a logistic regression baseline in scikit-learn, using training data to fit missing value imputation and feature standardization.
Compared regularization settings through stratified cross-validation and examined held-out precision, recall, and calibration plots to characterize prediction errors.
